Actual launcher validated collection metadata and trainer validated cache payloads before FIT. This is a pinned provenance chain, not a fresh independent replay acceptance.

Future evaluation source admission must independently bind the executing loader, imported c2_policy_refresh/c2_executor and full dependency snapshot to the correct host bytes. It must not modify the running FIT snapshot or infer evaluation admission from this report.

The loader validates recorded training precision; it does not configure future evaluation precision, task argv, device ownership, dataset protocol or scorer. Those belong to the later evaluation entry and runtime/source/input admission.
